label: PF Backlog 542
title: C10: Security-event audit/evidence (evidence-grade) + durable SecurityContext propagation
body:
## Problem / why
No security-EVENT store; authorization context can be lost across components.
## Acceptance criteria
Each security event records the doc field set (tenant/workspace/project/workflow/run/agent/user/provider/policy_version/input_hash/detector_results/risk/decision/tool/approval/artifact/result) with redaction+hashing+retention; a SecurityContext travels agent->gateway->tool->rag->sandbox->artifact->verify.
